incentives.description: Whether you're a new or existing ENGIE customer, we make moving easy. As long as you give us 1 full business day's notice, your electricity will be on when you ask for it, guaranteed, or we'll give you $500 credit back on your first bill.

Your offer includes a one-off welcome credit of $200, on your first electricity bill, provided you have not received a welcome credit from us in the past 12 months. This credit includes GST and is not redeemable for cash.

eligibility.description: To be eligible for this offer you must be moving house within 60 days of this contract start.

plans.terms: For further details on the information presented in this Plan Information Document, or for full terms and conditions, please visit www.engie.com.au or call ENGIE on 13 88 08. All time-dependent rates (eg. 4pm to 8pm) are billed in AEST. All time-dependent rates (eg. 4pm to 8pm) are billed in AEST.
